trivia: 'Squid Game' has the most amount of teaser images prior to its release, having 11 seperate images across 3 YouTube Community Posts.
The fonts for when Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto talk intentionally changes depending on if a cosplay is talking or the real character.
Despite the Vocaloid Quiz Splatshort featuring 4 different songs, the Splatshort somehow remains without any copyright restrictions.

The agent z Classic 'No Full Auto Hydra in Building' was made before 'I saw a Guy do this in a Toothpaste Ad Once' and was meant to release before it, but they swapped places due to April Fools and the latter video fitting the prank nature of the day more.

A drawing depicting agent z's computer breaking down in March 2026 was posted to Twitter and Bluesky and was supposed to be posted publicly to the YouTube Community Tab, but the computer got fixed before it could be.
Neo Agent 3 has voice acting in 'Celebrity Crush', primarily due to time constraints and agent z being unable to find audio clips or Inkling sounds that fit the tone of the scenes.
The first agent z Classic, 'I saw a Guy do this in a Toothpaste Ad Once', is technically an April Fools video hence stated in the video's description, depicting Agent X pulling a prank.

The original thumbnail used for 'Cooking Together' accidentally featured the old agent z logo, making it its last official appearance until it was swapped for a different thumbnail that uses a newer agent z logo.
'Celebrity Crush' is the first episode to feature licensed music.
'Clash of the Agents' mentions the possibility of a fourth agent, leading to speculations on a new character being introduced to the main cast. This never happened.
It is unknown who cosplays Akita Neru in 'Celebrity Crush'.
